sections.content: Passive voice fits patronage description well: favors were offered, a leader was recognized, allies were placed in posts, land was distributed — the resource or the person receiving the action stays the subject, which is exactly where a patronage network's real story lives. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Favores, tierras y protección eran ofrecidos personalmente por el caudillo a cambio de lealtad.
items.english: Favors, land and protection were personally offered by the caudillo in exchange for loyalty.

items.spanish: Páez fue reconocido como líder natural por otros llaneros acostumbrados a la vida dura del ganado.
items.english: Páez was recognized as a natural leader by other plainsmen used to the hard life of cattle-herding.

items.spanish: Sus antiguos compañeros de armas fueron colocados en puestos de confianza.
items.english: His former comrades-in-arms were placed in positions of trust.

items.spanish: Las tierras conquistadas o confiscadas durante las guerras fueron repartidas entre sus seguidores más cercanos.
items.english: Lands conquered or confiscated during the wars were distributed among his closest followers.

sections.content: Eran ofrecidos (imperfect passive) describes an ongoing practice, while fue reconocido and fueron colocados / repartidas (preterite passive) mark specific completed acts. A patronage-system description often needs both: the standing rule, and the concrete instances of it.
